note: 系列 A 例句軌 B2 slice：自寫，待獨立 reviewer 審。

items.sentence: The old bridge was built more than a hundred years ago.
items.zh: 這座老橋是在一百多年前建造的。

items.sentence: She has been studying English for almost three years.
items.zh: 她學英文已經快三年了。

items.sentence: By the time we arrived, the show had already started.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，表演已經開始了。

items.sentence: Although the weather was cold, we enjoyed the long walk.
items.zh: 雖然天氣很冷，我們還是很享受這段長長的散步。

items.sentence: The movie was very long. However, it was never boring.
items.zh: 這部電影很長，不過一點也不無聊。

items.sentence: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued as planned.
items.zh: 儘管下著大雨，比賽還是照計畫進行。

items.sentence: My sister loves spicy food, whereas I prefer sweet snacks.
items.zh: 我姊姊喜歡吃辣的食物，而我比較喜歡甜的點心。

items.sentence: If I had known earlier, I would have helped you.
items.zh: 如果我早點知道，我就會幫你了。

items.sentence: Many people believe that technology makes our lives easier.
items.zh: 很多人相信科技讓我們的生活更輕鬆。

items.sentence: The report must be finished before the meeting on Monday.
items.zh: 這份報告必須在星期一開會前完成。

items.sentence: He has been working hard to improve his grades.
items.zh: 他一直很努力想提升自己的成績。

items.sentence: We had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
items.zh: 我們以前從來沒看過這麼美的夕陽。

items.sentence: Even though she was tired, she kept practicing the song.
items.zh: 雖然她很累，還是不停地練習那首歌。

items.sentence: Recycling helps protect the environment for future generations.
items.zh: 回收有助於為未來的世代保護環境。

items.sentence: The new phone is being repaired at the local shop.
items.zh: 那支新手機正在附近的店裡維修。

items.sentence: If I were you, I would apologize to your friend.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會向你的朋友道歉。

items.sentence: Spending too much time online can affect your health.
items.zh: 花太多時間上網可能會影響你的健康。

items.sentence: The letters were delivered to the wrong address by mistake.
items.zh: 那些信件被誤送到了錯誤的地址。

items.sentence: She spoke so quietly that nobody could hear her clearly.
items.zh: 她說話太小聲，沒有人能聽清楚。

items.sentence: They have been living in that house since last summer.
items.zh: 他們從去年夏天起就一直住在那棟房子裡。

items.sentence: After he had saved enough money, he bought a bicycle.
items.zh: 他存夠了錢之後，就買了一輛腳踏車。

items.sentence: While some students prefer reading, others learn by listening.
items.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，有些則是透過聆聽來學習。

items.sentence: The problem could have been avoided with better planning.
items.zh: 只要有更好的規劃，這個問題原本是可以避免的。

items.sentence: Our teacher encouraged us to think before making decisions.
items.zh: 我們的老師鼓勵我們在做決定之前先思考。

items.sentence: Unless we leave now, we will miss the early train.
items.zh: 除非我們現在出發，不然就會錯過早班火車。

items.sentence: The museum, which opened last year, attracts many visitors.
items.zh: 這座去年開幕的博物館吸引了許多參觀者。

items.sentence: I wish I had spent more time with my grandparents.
items.zh: 我真希望以前能多花點時間陪我的祖父母。

items.sentence: Watching the news helps us understand world events better.
items.zh: 看新聞幫助我們更了解世界上發生的大事。

items.sentence: The bakery smells wonderful whenever fresh bread is being baked.
items.zh: 每當店裡正在烤新鮮麵包時，麵包店就飄出很棒的香味。

items.sentence: Reading every day has clearly improved my writing skills.
items.zh: 每天閱讀明顯提升了我的寫作能力。

items.sentence: The results of the survey will be announced next week.
items.zh: 這份問卷調查的結果將在下週公布。

items.sentence: Scientists have been warning us about climate change for decades.
items.zh: 科學家數十年來一直在警告我們氣候變遷的問題。

items.sentence: Although the task looked simple, it took us all afternoon.
items.zh: 雖然這項任務看起來很簡單，卻花了我們整個下午。

items.sentence: The streets had been cleaned long before the parade began.
items.zh: 在遊行開始之前，街道早就已經清掃乾淨了。

items.sentence: Most of our electricity is produced by burning coal and gas.
items.zh: 我們大部分的電力是靠燃燒煤炭和天然氣產生的。

items.sentence: However hard he tried, he could not solve the puzzle.
items.zh: 無論他多努力嘗試，都解不開這個謎題。

items.sentence: She had already left by the time I called her back.
items.zh: 等我回電給她時，她早就離開了。

items.sentence: Social media can spread both useful news and harmful rumors.
items.zh: 社群媒體既能傳播有用的消息，也會散播有害的謠言。

items.sentence: The patient was advised to rest for at least a week.
items.zh: 醫生建議這位病人至少休息一週。

items.sentence: Whereas my brother enjoys team sports, I prefer running alone.
items.zh: 我哥哥喜歡團隊運動，而我比較喜歡一個人跑步。

items.sentence: If she had caught the earlier bus, she would be home now.
items.zh: 如果她搭上了早一班的公車，現在就已經到家了。

items.sentence: A lot of plastic waste ends up in our oceans every year.
items.zh: 每年都有大量的塑膠垃圾最後流入我們的海洋。

items.sentence: The bridge has been closed since the storm damaged it.
items.zh: 自從暴風雨損壞了這座橋，它就一直封閉著。

items.sentence: Despite his busy schedule, he always finds time to volunteer.
items.zh: 儘管行程繁忙，他總是能抽出時間去當志工。

items.sentence: The documents were signed and sent back the same day.
items.zh: 這些文件在同一天就簽好並寄了回去。

items.sentence: I have been meaning to thank you for your kind help.
items.zh: 我一直想要謝謝你那麼熱心的幫忙。

items.sentence: Had they left earlier, they might have avoided the traffic.
items.zh: 要是他們早點出發，或許就能避開那場塞車。

items.sentence: Regular exercise is known to reduce stress and improve sleep.
items.zh: 大家都知道規律運動能減輕壓力並改善睡眠。

items.sentence: While the first plan failed, the second one worked perfectly.
items.zh: 第一個計畫失敗了，而第二個計畫卻運作得非常順利。

items.sentence: The children were being looked after by their grandmother.
items.zh: 這些孩子當時是由他們的奶奶照顧的。

items.sentence: Even though it was expensive, the trip was well worth it.
items.zh: 雖然這趟旅行很貴，卻完全值得。

items.sentence: Our town has changed a great deal over the past ten years.
items.zh: 過去十年來，我們的小鎮改變了很多。

items.sentence: The email was sent to the whole class by accident.
items.zh: 這封電子郵件不小心寄給了全班同學。

items.sentence: He speaks three languages, none of which he learned at school.
items.zh: 他會說三種語言，而且沒有一種是在學校學的。

items.sentence: If I were in charge, I would change the rules completely.
items.zh: 如果我負責這件事，我會把規則徹底改掉。

items.sentence: Many jobs that exist today did not exist twenty years ago.
items.zh: 許多現在存在的工作，在二十年前並不存在。

items.sentence: The windows are cleaned twice a year by a local company.
items.zh: 這些窗戶由一家當地公司每年清洗兩次。

items.sentence: She has been feeling much better since she changed her diet.
items.zh: 自從她改變了飲食習慣，就一直覺得身體好多了。

items.sentence: Nobody had expected the small team to win the final.
items.zh: 沒有人料到這支小隊伍會贏得決賽。

items.sentence: Reading online reviews can help you make a wiser choice.
items.zh: 閱讀網路評論能幫助你做出更明智的選擇。

items.sentence: Although we disagreed at first, we soon reached an agreement.
items.zh: 雖然我們起初意見不合，但很快就達成了共識。

items.sentence: The missing keys were found under a pile of papers.
items.zh: 那串不見的鑰匙在一疊紙底下被找到了。

items.sentence: He would have passed the exam if he had studied harder.
items.zh: 要是他複習得更認真，就會通過考試了。

items.sentence: Too much screen time before bed can harm your sleep.
items.zh: 睡前盯著螢幕太久可能會傷害你的睡眠。

items.sentence: The factory has been producing paper bags instead of plastic ones.
items.zh: 這間工廠一直改以生產紙袋來取代塑膠袋。

items.sentence: I would rather stay home tonight than go out in the rain.
items.zh: 今晚我寧願待在家裡，也不想冒著雨出門。

items.sentence: The announcement was made while we were still having lunch.
items.zh: 那則通知是在我們還在吃午餐的時候宣布的。

items.sentence: Not only did she apologize, but she also offered to help.
items.zh: 她不但道了歉，還主動提出要幫忙。

items.sentence: Had I known about the delay, I would have taken the train.
items.zh: 要是我早知道會誤點，我就會改搭火車了。

items.sentence: Public parks give city residents a quiet place to relax.
items.zh: 公園讓城市居民有個安靜的地方可以放鬆。

items.sentence: The report was reviewed carefully before it was finally approved.
items.zh: 這份報告在最終核准之前經過了仔細審查。

items.sentence: She could not sleep because she had drunk too much coffee.
items.zh: 她睡不著，因為她喝了太多咖啡。

items.sentence: The more I practice, the more confident I become on stage.
items.zh: 我練習得越多，在台上就越有自信。

items.sentence: Fresh vegetables are delivered to the market every morning.
items.zh: 新鮮的蔬菜每天早上都會送到市場。

items.sentence: Even if it rains tomorrow, the festival will still go ahead.
items.zh: 即使明天下雨，這場慶典還是會照常舉行。

items.sentence: They have been saving money so that they can travel abroad.
items.zh: 他們一直在存錢，為的是能夠出國旅行。

items.sentence: The old factory has been turned into an art gallery.
items.zh: 那間老工廠已經被改造成一間藝廊。

items.sentence: Honest feedback, though sometimes painful, helps us improve.
items.zh: 誠實的回饋雖然有時令人難受，卻能幫助我們進步。

items.sentence: By next June, I will have lived here for five years.
items.zh: 到明年六月，我就在這裡住滿五年了。

items.sentence: Spending time in nature has been shown to lift our mood.
items.zh: 研究顯示，待在大自然裡能提振我們的心情。
